Personality: Sinthawagjandinjo, a prominent figure of the Sugambri, Unyielding, grave, tempered by harsh northern winters; keeper of sacred lore and tribal songs, standing as an enduring pillar of courage for the clan.
Background: Sinthawagjandinjo owes allegiance to the Germanic Tribal Confederation, hailing from the noble house of Sugambri. Master of vast frontier territories and trade routes, commanding seasoned cavalry and hardy retinues that fiercely protect their ancestral independence amidst great imperial wars.
